_comment: Reference banks from REAL Kaggriculture ladder episodes, pulled with the
Kaggle episode replay API. Each row is the winning bank from an episode
played by the public agent that dominates the top of the leaderboard,
together with the seed that episode ran on, so the same board can be
replayed locally and compared like for like.
This is the only honest strength target in the repository. Beating the
built-in starter, or any agent in benchmark/incumbent or benchmark/rival,
says nothing: those all finish 6x below this.
Note the spread -- 59k to 125k on the same agent. It is driven by the
